statement:
by
  classical
  let chen := fun p : ℕ => Nat.Prime p ∧ (p+2).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2
  let good := fun n : ℕ => ∃ p q : ℕ, chen p ∧ chen q ∧ p+q=n
  exact ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, T ≤ X → ∀ H : ℕ, X ≤ H^2 → H ≤ X →
    (((Finset.Icc X (X+H)).filter (fun n => n%6=4 ∧ ¬good n)).card:ℝ) ≤ (H:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在每个长度至少 √X 的目标短窗内证明双陈素数表示的幂节省例外界。
plain_statement.en: Power-saving exceptional sets for two Chen primes in every target interval of length at least √X.

brief.zh: 原论文定理 1.1 给累计例外界，容许例外集中在短窗。本题要求对每个起点 X 成立，且损失以窗口长度 H 计算。加数仍可自由变化；这与现有要求 p、q 彼此接近的任务不同。
brief.en: Theorem 1.1 permits clustering of exceptions. Localize the exceptional-set argument in the target and preserve a saving measured in H. The summands remain unrestricted in distance.
